# Kent & Vale

> Kent & Vale is a bespoke British furniture and heirloom commission studio based in Sittingbourne, Kent, England. Every piece is handmade to commission — never from a catalogue, never repeated.

## What we make

Kent & Vale works in two collections:

**Forever Form** — Heirloom commissions that preserve life's most meaningful moments in resin and wood. Wedding flowers, pet memorials, family keepsakes, milestone objects. Made to be kept for generations.

**The Games Room** — Bespoke game boards built to last lifetimes. Chess sets, backgammon boards, collector editions, and personalised family heirlooms. Made for play, display, and inheritance.

## How it works

Every commission begins with a conversation. No catalogue, no off-the-shelf options. Clients describe what they want the piece to hold — a memory, a moment, a game — and Kent & Vale designs and builds it by hand. The typical process runs 12–18 weeks from consultation to delivery.

## Who we are

A small studio of makers and craftspeople working from Kent, England. We use named-source English timber (walnut, oak), professional-grade epoxy resin, and bespoke finishing techniques. We take a limited number of commissions each month to ensure full attention to every piece.

## Pricing

- Entry Bespoke: £800–£2,500 (small pieces, keepsakes, simpler game boards)
- Mid-Premium Signature: £2,500–£12,000 (dining tables, larger memorial pieces, collector game boards)
- Luxury Statement: £12,000–£60,000+ (large-scale statement pieces, corporate commissions)
